exposure: Previous delivery history (spontaneous preterm labor, planned preterm birth, planned cesarean section at term)
Planned elective repeat cesarean section (ERCS) at 39-41 weeks gestation
outcome: Rate of spontaneous labor before 39 weeks
cohort: 32,934 women in New South Wales, Australia, from 2007-2010 who were planned to have an ERCS at 39-41 weeks gestation
finding: 8.5% of low-risk women planned for ERCS at 39-41 weeks gestation went into spontaneous labor before 39 weeks, with the risk varying depending on previous delivery history.
mod_finding: The study found that 8.5% of low-risk women planned for a repeat elective cesarean section went into spontaneous labor before 39 weeks, with the risk varying based on prior delivery history, including preterm labor and previous cesarean sections.
